summary: Validated public backend boundaries and the unauthenticated Expo web entry point at 390x844. Login, disclaimer, Google CTA touch target, no-overflow behavior, API root, and protected 401 responses passed. Authenticated flows were not executable because no Google test identity is available.

integration_issues.issue: The Upload your story path only reveals the same north-star/tone form; there is no story upload or text import control.
Task creation does not request local reminders, and the UI has no completion interaction or overdue/upcoming/done grouping despite the requested task behavior.
No speech-to-text control is present for check-in, onboarding, domains, tasks, or companion text entry.

action_items: Implement a real Upload your story input/import flow and persist its content.
Add local reminder request during task setup and task completion plus overdue/upcoming/done grouping.
Add device speech-to-text affordances wherever text is entered.
Provide authenticated regression coverage once a Google test identity/session is available.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend API base uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (with an extra backendUrl fallback), while the stated contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep the environment key contract consistent.
The reflection AI draft is labeled but is not editable and has no edit/dismiss affordance.
The companion safety response is generated server-side and labeled only through returned data; the UI does not visibly distinguish safety fallback state beyond the response text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No credentials exist in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public URL tested: https://companion-compass.preview.emergentagent.com/. Authenticated workspace, onboarding save, check-in, tasks, domains, reflection, companion, and user-isolation flows remain unverified.
rca_of_issue: The listed feature gaps are present in frontend/app/index.tsx: onboarding path-document shares the questionnaire form, Tasks only POSTs title/dueDate, and all text inputs lack speech recognition controls. These are missing UI/API integrations rather than runtime failures.
